global: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glows in a white bowl, topped with tender chashu pork, shredded cabbage, and fresh greens. Warm lighting highlights the rich red broth and toppings against a softly blurred, dark background.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and reflective sheen near edges.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly curved rim showing orange-brown residue stains.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is vibrant red, glossy, and thick, swirling around thin noodles and garnishes.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice has golden-brown crust, tender white interior, and thin green garnish on its surface.
